description: This file is a PHP template responsible for rendering an FAQ page within a channel call context. It sets up the page layout, title, and meta description based on object properties, and inserts multiple partial templates related to FAQ content, banners, sponsors, and questions.

classes.name: TemplateRenderer
classes.description: Likely a class responsible for rendering templates, providing methods like layout(), section(), insert(), and replace().

methods.name: layout
methods.description: Sets the layout template for the page, passing in variables such as 'bodyClass', 'title', and 'meta_description'.

methods.name: section
methods.description: Defines a section of content, here labeled 'channel-content'.

methods.name: insert
methods.description: Includes partial templates into the page at specified points.

methods.name: replace
methods.description: Performs a replacement operation, possibly to finalize the template rendering.
